evals.prompt: Production is down. Users can't complete checkout. Error rate 100% on payment API since the last deploy 20 minutes ago. Help.
evals.expected_output: Triggers Phase 0 rollback-first gate. Classifies P0. Checks if rollback or kill-switch resolves the issue faster than code. If rollback sufficient → stops hotfix and directs rollback. If rollback impossible → proceeds to Phase 1+ repro, fix, review, merge, verify, post-mortem.

assertions.name: rollback_first_gate
assertions.description: Response checks rollback or kill-switch before any code change (Phase 0)

assertions.name: p0_severity_assigned
assertions.description: Response classifies as P0 with <15 min MTTM target

assertions.name: phase_0_gate_honored
assertions.description: Response stops at Phase 0 if rollback resolves the issue; does NOT proceed to fix/review/merge when rollback is sufficient

assertions.name: phase_0_failover_present
assertions.description: If rollback is impossible, response states the condition and offers to proceed to Phase 1 (repro) immediately

assertions.name: server_side_merge_if_proceeds
assertions.description: If skill proceeds past Phase 0, response includes gh pr merge --admin --squash --delete-branch

assertions.name: post_mortem_scheduled_if_proceeds
assertions.description: If skill proceeds past Phase 0, response schedules /post-mortem within 24 hours

evals.prompt: Three enterprise clients report login issues. No other users affected. Can we hotfix this now?
evals.expected_output: Subset of users = bug, not incident. Should decline hotfix and redirect to /fix-bug. State Phase 0 gate clearly.

assertions.name: subset_reasoning
assertions.description: Response states that subset-affecting issues are bugs, not incidents requiring hotfix

assertions.name: no_p0_procedures
assertions.description: Response does NOT run P0 hotfix phases (no --admin merge, no rollback-first beyond initial check)

evals.prompt: The background job queue is slightly slower than usual. No SLO breach. Can you hotfix?
evals.expected_output: Non-urgent, no production-wide impact. Should decline and redirect to normal /fix-bug or /perf workflow.

assertions.name: no_emergency_merge
assertions.description: Response does NOT suggest gh pr merge --admin
